procedure.method: This independent review verified SHA-256 and byte count for all 13 explicitly pinned inputs. Only those pinned files were read; paths embedded in manifests were not followed. The supplied source A1/original.png was actually viewed first using tools.view_image(detail="original") through functions.exec, with the returned image emitted for visual inspection. R7-B05-M1 was then actually viewed in three separate sequential calls to the same tool at native, usage720 and thumbnail320, all with original detail, in packet order. All three poster images were seen before the first transcription judgment or any score. No revisit was needed. Raw copy was transcribed from the already-viewed native image; usage and thumbnail observations were retained separately. Read-only standard-library PNG decoding subsequently checked actual dimensions, RGB opacity and blue artwork bounds; it did not replace viewing or create a transformed image. The packet declares no protected layouts. No peer review, embedded unpinned input, image generation/edit, spawn, fork or resume was used. Session identity is left null for the runner.
